scope: Finite contract/fault-condition design review of existing helpers. New code is still being edited; no final implementation acceptance or test run is claimed.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Pure early returns do not validate a structural request
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: decision._evaluate_decision checks policy/position/thesis status before quote/source validation.
references: research/ir-public-decision-review-design-2026-10-15/README.md:必要な場合だけ足す最小契約
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Supply an invalid bound price/company/path while position is unknown or policy parameters are missing. Pure currently returns unresolved before reaching the bad binding.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: The new wrapper rejects a supplied malformed identity/quote binding with zero new review rows, while valid incomplete quote/settings may remain unresolved. Do not change the old pure early-return order.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Perform structural/reference validation before pure calculation. If extracting the existing quote validation into a narrow shared helper, preserve old return reasons/order and current quote normalization behavior.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Closure collection is not cycle/publicity/availability certification
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: DecisionLifecycle.sources_for collects thesis and quote origins, deduplicates IDs, and rejects wrong-company loaded sources; it does not itself detect a cycle. Store.source_availability checks receipt/effective time/company/cycles, not publicity or synthetic provenance.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: A second parent is missing, late, different-company, held, synthetic, or forms a cycle. A shared valid parent should remain valid. Include a quote-origin case, not only thesis roots.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Every selected original source in both closures is checked and saved with SHA; no hidden second parent or quote ancestor may make a real/public-only result appear clean.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Reuse existing closure/availability/publicity contracts as separate checks. Do not call the schedule reader as a generic decision validator: its schedule scope rejects market sources.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Raw latest CAS differs from strict-current selection and aggregate diagnostics
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: Store.thesis_view may select an older visible thesis when the raw newest is future/unknown; availability_status can be partial solely due to an unrelated excluded older legacy row.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Raw v2 is future/unusable but v1 is currently visible; separately, latest valid v2 has unrelated old v1 legacy unknown.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Expected version must equal raw newest and selected usable version; never silently compute from v1 in the former case. In the latter, inspect selected_availability rather than blanket-rejecting aggregate partial solely due to old excluded rows.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Check selected record identity and its selected receipt/source diagnostics explicitly; retain excluded diagnostics without changing the existing PIT reader.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Current receipt and historical prior use are distinct claims
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: RecordAvailability.at returns known-by evidence for legacy_presence and exact first-save evidence for trusted_insert. Current availability alone is not proof of existence at a prior thesis date.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: An old-dated source/thesis is inserted now, or a legacy row is only known present now.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: A current baseline uses its trusted actual current evaluation time and preserves receipt diagnostics; never label it a historical/PIT or pre-outcome decision. If any prior-usage-time claim is made, verify that cutoff separately rather than infer it from current available=true.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Do not add historical write modes or require a reconstructed exact legacy first save where current known-by evidence is the only claim. Unknown/unavailable selected evidence remains unresolved.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Explicit positions must not fall back across unqualified observations
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: Store.declared_position_at examines the latest observation and requires its own explicit_user_declaration receipt. It intentionally does not search backward for an older declared value.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Company import defaults held=false; or an older declared true is followed by an undeclared observation; or held changes after save.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Unknown remains unknown on save/current view. Imported company.held and stale declarations cannot authorize a financial action. Saved result stays historical after a later position change.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Use declared_position_at directly and do not add a new synthetic_position override to this thin API unless separately required. A same-held redeclaration need not create a new financial rule; keep any stricter identity comparison explicit.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Reply assessment helper is not complete original-reply binding
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: source_assessments(reply_id=None) discovers metadata.reply_id only on supplied ir_reply sources and returns latest visible saved assessments; no history returns an empty mapping. It does not validate the reply/question receipt or certify missing metadata as public.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: An IR ancestor has missing reply_id, unknown reply/question, no visible assessment, or immutable source metadata remains held after a later public classification.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Do not infer public-only from an empty assessment mapping. Saved source metadata holds and absent/held underlying reply bindings remain visible. A positive assessment is not permission to rewrite immutable source metadata.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Inspect full closure types and original bindings separately; reuse saved source-publicity logic. public-only may be true only for a complete usable no-IR closure.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Current classification changes must not silently be consumed
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: current_decision_view treats an unconsumed later public_clarification version as needing review as well as a held version. It depends on reply_id and cannot directly accept a research record.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: After saving, dependency classification changes to potential_nonpublic and then back to public_clarification with a new version. Include a quote-ancestor reply.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Current view is unresolved for the hold and remains review-required for the unconsumed public version. Historical_result is unchanged; a new current baseline needs a new ID.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Save consumed version mapping, call source_assessments over the complete saved closure, and compare versions. Do not invent a dummy reply_id to reuse the old current wrapper.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Retry identity must precede latest CAS and use fixed policy version
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: Existing immutable records/requests return their first result on exact retry. Fixed policy rows and first_saved_at are available independently of any newest policy version.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Exact same ID/request after thesis advances or quote expires; same ID with changed quote/policy/assessment; newer policy version published after saving.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Exact retry returns original immutable record and first_saved_at before CAS; current projection may only add holds. Changed request rejects. New IDs require the newest applicable thesis and the explicitly selected registered policy version.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Use one new table with request digest and exact request; no extra generic receipt registry or latest-policy auto-selection.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Existing current helpers certify only narrow checks
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: _current_quote_check checks timing against saved result quote/policy. _current_thesis_check compares raw version only; neither certifies position, full availability, review deadline or all source-publicity corrections.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Price age is exactly limit and limit+1µs; JST next_review_date becomes due; latest thesis changes or becomes unusable; position becomes unknown; historical result was already unresolved.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Use the existing boundary semantics, add only required current holds, never upgrade a past unresolved result by current display or mutate its history. Selected availability is checked in addition to raw version.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: A research-only current wrapper can reuse narrow timing/version helpers and append its own required checks; do not broaden the old reply current view.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Synthetic provenance includes source ancestors, not only policy
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: evaluate_decision rejects a non-synthetic context with synthetic_example policy but does not by itself reject metadata.synthetic on every source/thesis ancestor. Model-input/read-only provenance helper has an explicit source synthetic check.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: A real request uses a real-looking policy and a synthetic second-parent/quote source or thesis marker.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Never promote synthetic source/thesis/position evidence into a real current baseline. The caller cannot erase trusted source synthetic provenance.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: Add the explicit complete-closure synthetic consistency check in the wrapper; do not alter financial parameters or invent assumptions.

required_fault_conditions.topic: Atomic save and trusted current clock only
required_fault_conditions.existing_contract: Store._record_write supports nested savepoints; RecordAvailability entity types are intentionally limited. Current code schemas and caller JSON are separate contracts.
required_fault_conditions.fault_condition: Clock sampled before lock; caller supplies held/snapshot/action/as_of; calculation or insert fails after validation; transaction retry races with another writer.
required_fault_conditions.required_result: Trusted clock sampled after write lock; no caller snapshots or past write cutoff; calculation/snapshot/result/request/new-row save is atomic. No thesis/company/source/question/reply mutation.
required_fault_conditions.minimal_action: A new table first_saved_at is sufficient. Do not add a new RecordAvailability entity or second request receipt table. Keep old decision_reviews.reply_id NOT NULL and old JSON/API behavior intact.

safe_simplifications: Keep finance arithmetic and all pure policy decisions in evaluate_decision. The new layer resolves DB records and binds evidence; it need not duplicate valuation arithmetic or market rules.

A narrowly extracted quote-binding helper can enforce wrapper structure without changing the old pure early-return order. Test old contracts before/after extraction, particularly missing policy/position and derived J-Quants quote normalization.

Current-only writes plus a separate read projection avoid historical write modes, performance scoring, question/reply fabrication, source invalidation, scheduler work or extra ledgers. None of those are needed for a saved current baseline.
final_review_focus_after_root_signal: Inspect wrapper validation order and any quote-helper extraction while preserving old pure semantics.
Check required failure groups with focused isolated fixtures and existing legacy regression tests; root owns the full suite run.
Check request/CAS order, selected availability rather than aggregate legacy status, all-source synthetic/publicity closure, version changes and current-view holds.
limits: These notes identify risks in composing existing helpers, not confirmed bugs in the unfinished implementation.
No new requirement for financial thresholds, issuer forecasts, exact historical first saves, or additional IR questions is introduced.
Function references identify contracts as inspected; the implementation may extract helpers before the final review, which will require fresh code inspection.
